name: Lower leg
note: Schematic right lower leg from behind, not to scale. Positions follow standard anatomy atlases (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, 1918, public domain); shapes are simplified for teaching.

gastroc-medial.name: Gastrocnemius, medial head
gastroc-medial.action: Points the foot (plantarflexion); also bends the knee

gastroc-lateral.name: Gastrocnemius, lateral head
gastroc-lateral.action: Points the foot (plantarflexion); also bends the knee

soleus.name: Soleus
soleus.action: Points the foot; works whatever the knee angle (crosses only the ankle)

views.title: Back
views.caption: Right calf from behind: knee at the top, outer side on the right.

views.title: Back, deep layer
views.caption: Gastrocnemius removed: the soleus underneath, joining the Achilles tendon.
